verdict.rationale: Pilot is a done-for-you bookkeeping service. Work does happen in the background: integrations with banks, Expensify and cards handle transaction classification, cutting founder time to zero (pilot-comm-1, pilot-comm-4), and the R&D credit is auto-applied via Gusto (pilot-docs-25). However, this is run by Pilot's team and integrations rather than automations the user sets up, and 'Custom workflows' (pilot-docs-10) is only a vague pricing line. missing for 10: user-configurable automation builder, triggers/schedules, agentic or AI-driven autonomous actions, documentation of how custom workflows are created, independent corroboration of user-defined automations.
